visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a metal spoon lifting a rectangular block of soft, golden tofu drenched in a thick, savory brown meat sauce with visible bits of black beans and fresh green onions. The lighting is bright and appetizing, highlighting the moisture and texture of the ingredients. (2) A male chef in a professional white uniform with purple floral patterns on the sleeves and collar eats a spoonful of the dish. He displays a high-arousal facial expression of genuine surprise and delight, nodding and smiling at the camera against a white brick wall background. (3) The instructional phase begins with a hand in a plastic glove coating cubes of egg tofu in white flour within a light blue bowl. The cubes are then placed into a grey non-stick pan, sizzling as they are fried until both sides develop a crispy, golden-brown crust. (4) The chef prepares the sauce by sautéing minced pork in a yellow pan with a blue spatula. He adds diced garlic and red chilies, then incorporates two spoonfuls of dark fermented black beans from a branded jar and a pour of dark soy sauce. (5) A jar of '黑豆桑' fermented black beans is showcased on a red and blue striped tablecloth next to a small wooden bowl of beans. The camera zooms in to show the glossy, dark black texture of the beans, emphasizing their high quality and artisan appearance. (6) Final seasonings including white sugar, pepper, sesame oil, and rice wine are added to the pan along with clear broth. The fried tofu cubes are returned to the sauce, and a starch slurry is poured in to create a glossy, thick glaze that coats every component. (7) The completed tofu pot is presented in a white clay bowl, garnished with a generous amount of chopped green onions and fresh cilantro. A final close-up shows the spoon lifting the tofu again, emphasizing its silky interior and the rich, clinging sauce.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice describing the texture of the tofu, accompanied by a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. The vocal arousal is high, conveying immediate enthusiasm. (2) A metallic clink sound occurs as the chef picks up a spoon, followed by a wet, percussive chewing sound and a high-pitched 'Mmm' vocalization. The music continues steadily with a cheerful piano melody layered over the guitar. (3) A 'whoosh' transition sound triggers a shift to instructional narration. The sizzling sound of frying tofu adds high-frequency noise and percussive transients, while the narrator maintains a clear, professional tone with precise articulation. (4) Frequent 'click' and 'clack' sounds of kitchen utensils interacting with pans are heard. The narrator introduces the '黑豆桑' brand with increased vocal intensity and resonance, emphasizing its importance in the recipe. (5) A resonant 'pop' and glass clink indicate a jar being opened. The narrator's pitch rises as he describes the aroma, creating a sense of climax in the product promotion. The BGM remains consistently energetic. (6) A series of 'splash' and 'plop' sounds represent various liquids being added to the pan, creating a dense acoustic environment. The narrator lists ingredients with a fast speech rate but maintains clarity. (7) A final 'ding' sound effect marks the completion of the dish. The music swells slightly as the narrator delivers a friendly concluding statement with a rising intonation, encouraging viewers to try the recipe.
